# The Liability Board
Every incident is an opportunity, provided you can write the paperwork convincingly.
- What it is: a wallmounted board listing active bounties — short-term objectives the Company will reward if you convince it you completed one. Your claim is judged by the Directive against everything else submitted this round, not scored on a fixed rubric.
- Where to find it: look for the LIABILITY BOARD wallmount, present on every rotation map.
- Steps to first success: - Click the board to see the current open bounties and their descriptions. - Pick one that matches something you can actually do (or already did) this shift. - Submit a short, honest claim describing what happened. Specific beats vague — the Directive is reading for substance, not length. - The board tells you the verdict directly once judged; there is no separate "pending" screen to check back on, but judging is not instant, so give it a moment. - A rejected claim is not a permanent mark against you — the board refreshes with new bounties often enough that there is always another chance.
- Bounty rewards, like everything the Directive judges, are shaped by whatever else was submitted in the same round. Do not expect the exact same claim to score the same way twice.
